messages:
maria: FYI seeing ~1.5% schema failures on tool-hook responses from private deployments since the 14:12 deploy. Errors look like 'missing field: action.type'. Example payload in logs below.
aj: Ugh, are these coming from model-side or adapter? Can you paste a sample log?
maria: Log snippet:
```json
{"request_id":"req_9c1","tool":"webhook.send","status":"schema_error","errors":[{"path":"$.result.action","msg":"missing required property 'type'"}]}
```
sam: That path is from the structured output spec we tightened last week. Did the rollout pin go out to Dedicated/Private? I thought it was just hosted.
leo: It was a global config flip at 14:12 by rollout-service. Looks like we didn't scope to hosted only. Rollout ID rlt-2026-77
irene: If that's true, customers with older tool adapters will break. We need a graceful fallback—either allow partial parses or route to legacy transformer.
maria: Agreed. Current behavior rejects entire tool invocation and surfaces error to the app which is rough. Can we change to 'soft-validate' for 48h? :hourglass:
aj: Telemetry quick check: ~230 unique customers affected, mostly private, spike exactly at the flag flip. Attaching dashboard: https://console.redwood/dashboards/schema/overview (will share panel id after)
deploy-bot: rollout-service changed config rlt-2026-77: strict_schema=true -> true at 2026-03-18T14:12:07Z
sam: Proposal: revert strict flag for private deployments immediately, push hotfix to adapters to accept optional 'action.type', and emit structured regression events for missing fields so we can track impact. Also add a console notice for affected customers.
leo: For the API semantics debate: do we standardize on 'lenient-by-default' and opt-in strictness per-customer, or keep strict-by-default and opt-in leniency? Long term this affects routing policies too.
irene: Per-customer policy is safer. For now, set private -> lenient for 48h and schedule a real migration window (30 days) with tests.
maria: I'll open a follow-up PR that adds a soft-validate flag + telemetry tag (schema.migration=soft). Can someone handle the console notice and CS comms?
aj: I'll draft the console banner + CS message and share with legal. Ping me for wording.
sam: I'll cut a patch for dedicated-adapter v1.14.1 to accept missing action.type and map to action.type="unknown" for compatibility; will add integration test and a regression eval.
maria: Thanks. Please paste rollout IDs and PR links back into this thread when done. Keeping thread open for status. :thumbsup:
